dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: "So swiftly now, stop and rest. Hurry not, do not press"... Oh, it's you. Is there something I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I was hoping I could borrow your instrument.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Please do! I can't wait to hear the melody you'll play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about your dream.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: My parents were extremely resistant to the idea of me being a bard. They were hoping I might be an academic, but I've never been the scholarly type...

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Those were the days when they'd lock me in my room and force me to study. The only joy I got was from hearing the bards sing outside the window.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: That got me interested, and then after I grew up, I just wanted to be a bard. Even if it meant falling out with my parents, I had to give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Now, thanks to you, I no longer stammer when performing.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: I'll become a legendary bard in Mondstadt... One day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen someone who looks very much like me?

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Someone who looks like you? ...Yes! I do believe I have!

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Now, where did I...

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: #Ah yes! I remember! It was when I was a child. That was my favorite picture book, that was... the protagonist had beautiful {F#blonde}{M#blond} hair, just like you!

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Oh— Looking for a relative? I'm sorry, I... I misunderstood.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: I've never seen anyone that looks like you in real life, no. As it happens, you have a very distinctive appearance — so, I'll keep a look out!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you then.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Best of luck! Do come hear me perform when you have the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I was hoping I could borrow your instrument.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Please do! I can't wait to hear the melody you'll play.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Perfect timing. Listen to this:

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Goo—Goo—Good Evening, la—la—ladies and... and... and...

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: ... *sigh* I still can't do it. As soon it's a performance, my stammer just gets out of control...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Stammer?

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: I'm practicing for my first-ever performance. But I'm so nervous!

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: I can speak fine normally. But as soon as I'm aware that I'm performing, I get all tense and tongue-tied...

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: But I've always dreamed of doing this. I've gotta keep trying!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me more about your dream.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: My parents were extremely resistant to the idea of me being a bard. They said there'd be no job security whatsoever...

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: They were hoping I might be an academic, but my research skills are dire...

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Those were the days when they'd lock me in my room and force me to study. The only joy I got was from hearing the bards sing outside the window.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: That got me interested, and then after I grew up I just wanted to be a bard. Even if it meant falling out with my parents. I had to give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: This is the path I've chosen, and I'll find a way round any obstacles in my way... Even the stammer. I know I can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best of luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: Thank you. One day, I'll become a legendary bard of Mondstadt... One day!

dialogues.speaker: Sansa
dialogues.text: ...Provided that I can overcome the stammer, of course...
